verdict.rationale: The product has a public GitHub repository (github.com/mozilla-ai/llamafile), so its source is readable, and Mozilla.ai lists it under "open-tools." A community comment about code commits supports public development. However, no evidence names the license or confirms it is an OSI-approved open license. Missing for 10: an explicit license statement (e.g., Apache 2.0) in docs or repo, and independent confirmation of the licensing terms.
